correctness.rationale: For explicitly fixed GP(10,3) Desargues graph (not the different Desargues-name graph), the 30 odd-scale Čech generators N[u]∪N[v] each have six vertices. Independent exact enumeration gives 1,230 faces and f-vector (20,150,440,410,180,30), Euler characteristic 50. Full deterministic elementary free-face collapse removes 472 face-coface pairs and leaves a (20,118,148) two-complex. On that complex 19 spanning-tree vertex-edge pairs and 99 non-tree edge-triangle matches leave 1 critical vertex and 49 triangles. Independently oriented every matched/unmatched incidence in the original full Hasse diagram (4,340 incidences) and topologically sorted all 1,230 nodes, confirming complete acyclicity. Forman yields integral wedge ∨^{49}S² with no torsion or π₁, not merely matching mod-two Betti numbers; pure 5D implies not shellable.

The exact ∨^{49}S² and pure-dimension-five non-shellability provide a reproducible integral benchmark and a meaningful topology transition, not just a tiny parameter substitution.
